Thousands of kritis, mostly in **Telugu**, mostly in praise of **Rama**; **Pancharatna kritis** (five gems, in Ghana ragas); created **new ragas**; musical dramas **Prahlada Bhakti Vijayam** and **Nauka Charitram** (**Nauka Charitram = Tyagaraja**)
1,000+ Shringara **padams**; sang at **Abdullah Qutb Shah**'s court
Mostly in praise of **Rama, not Krishna**
Tyagaraja, **Muthuswami Dikshitar**, **Syama Sastri** (**Annamacharya is not one of them**)
**Padams, keertanas, satakas and dvipadas** fed Carnatic music
Maharajapuram Viswanatha Iyer, Semmangudi Srinivasa Iyer, Musiri Subramania Iyer
New **Annamayya district** (named after him), April **2022**; with the **Rajampet division, back to YSR Kadapa district** from **1 Jan 2026**
About **32,000** to **Lord Venkateswara of Tirumala**; about **12,000** survive on **copper plates** found at Tirumala (**1922**)

**Sri Venkateswara Satakam** (first Telugu Shringara Satakam), Sringara Manjari, Sankirtana Lakshanam (Sanskrit)
**Subhadra Kalyanam** (Subhadra Parinayam), also Rukmini Kalyanam; **first woman poet of Telugu**
**Paramayogi Vilasam**, **Annamacharya Charitra** (dvipada biography), Usha Kalyanam, Ashtamahishi Kalyanam

North bank of the Krishna, across from Srisailam – **Nagarkurnool district, Telangana**
**Basavanna (Basaveshwara)**, 12th c., a **Brahmana**; **minister of the Kalachuri ruler Bijjala II** at **Kalyana**
**Shiva** as the **Ishtalinga** worn on the body

3.x: **Social message:** rejected caste, **untouchability** and Brahmanical ritual, **condemned child marriage**, **questioned the theory of rebirth**, and encouraged practices the **Dharmashastras disapproved** – **post-puberty marriage and widow remarriage**.
**Siddhas (Sittars)** of Tamil Nadu were **monotheistic and condemned idolatry**.

r: **Spread Virashaivism in Andhra** (Kakatiya age); founder of **Aradhya Saivism** (moderate, kept Vedic learning and varna); **Sivatattvasaram**; originator of the Sataka form in Telugu; one of the Panchacharyas
Later Telugu poet of Virashaivism: **Basava Puranam** (Telugu **dwipada**) and **Panditaradhya Charitra**; Vrushadhipa Satakam (first full-featured satakam)
**Bammera** (Jangaon dt., Telangana); one tradition places him at **Vontimitta (Ontimitta), Kadapa**
Contemporary of **Srinatha**; Pedakomati Vema Reddy's age
**Refused to dedicate** his work to a king (**Sarvajna Singabhupala of Rachakonda**)
**His first work**, at the request of his guru **Ivaturi Somanaradhya**

Potter family of Gopavaram; **first Telugu poetess to write the Ramayana**

r: **Kalagnanam** – prophecies of the evils of Kali Yuga
**Ataveladi** metre; refrain "Vishwadabhirama Vinura Vema"; satire on caste, ritual, idol worship, superstition
Condemned caste; disciples of all castes and faiths – **Siddaiah (a Muslim, Dudekula)**, Kakkaiah (Madiga)

6.x: **C.P. Brown** collected and translated the **Verses of Vemana (1829)**.

**Social impact:** Bhakti did not uniformly uphold Brahmanical dominance – Basava, Vemana and Veerabrahmam attacked caste; the **satakam and dwipada** carried Bhakti to common people; Telugu replaced Sanskrit as its vehicle.
